summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed by Mama's Creations, Inc. for an underwritten public offering of 5,555,556 shares of common stock at $18.00 per share, expected to raise $100 million before underwriting discounts. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under an automatic shelf registration statement, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or other special event. The company uses the net proceeds for general corporate purposes. This filing represents a routine capital markets transaction well within the scope of a standard follow-on offering.
